title: fix(chatbot): Built-badge for built plans + visible liveness timer & offline state
body:
AI build chat-UX fixes from founder dogfood (objectstack-ai/cloud#441 companion).

## Changes
- **#3 "Build it" re-click** — after a build completed, the earlier "Proposed plan" card kept its active "Build it" button; clicking it re-sent the approval and rebuilt the whole app. A plan is now "built" once an `apply_blueprint` invocation appears after it (keyed on `toolName`, so it survives a reload that strips the rich `draftReview`). When built, the actions collapse to an inert "Built" badge; a later, not-yet-built plan keeps its live button. Adds `planBuiltLabel` (localized zh "已搭建").
- **#2 Visible liveness** — the loading indicator was too faint, showed no countdown before the first server byte, and never surfaced a network drop. Now: `LivenessIndicator` shows the live `m:ss` timer in EVERY tier (not only `receiving`); a new `offline` tier driven by `navigator.onLine` + online/offline events shows a red WifiOff "Connection lost — reconnecting…" instantly; a `ToolRunningTimer` puts the same timer + offline cue on running tool chips ("Propose blueprint · Running") and the build progress panel. Adds `connectionStalledLabel`/`connectionOfflineLabel`.

## Verification
- 47 ChatbotEnhanced tests pass (new: always-on timer, offline tier, running-tool timer; updated stall format).
- Live (console dev proxied to the EE rig): "Built" badge on a built plan vs active "Build it" on an un-built one in the same conversation; `🕐 m:ss` timer in the build panel; browser "Offline" + "Response failed · Retry" on a dropped turn.

Note: reaches production via the objectui → framework `.objectui-sha` pin → cloud bump flow.
